name: Alcorcón (Spain)
description: Red field with a green stripe along the fly, charged towards the hoist with the crowned municipal arms of Alcorcón (three cauldrons on red above a green mount).
history: The official flag is described as square, gyronny at the hoist of yellow, red and green, charged with the municipal arms; although two official versions of the arms and flag exist, the town council of Alcorcón uses simpler alternative versions such as this one.

features.role: Alcorcón arms — three cauldrons on red above a green mount
